comment:
I really appreciate that you consult the community. I also think it is good that this app is for now untouched by AI. On the other hand I'm not an anti-AI absolutionist. Consulting AI sometimes is fine I think. As for AI features in the app. If they make sense it could be interesting and I would prefer local: remember also AI is not only about LLMs. 

I think maybe there is also room for an separate/new AI developed budgeting app but I don't think buckets needs to be it.
